name: T12-WF01 - AI CRM Lead Qualification Agent

parameters.content:
## 1. RabbitMQ Ingestion & Validation
Dedicated queue receives qualification requests only.

## 2. Authoritative CRM Context
Read Lead and recent interactions from NestJS using workflow-run scope.

## 3. Gemini Qualification & Confidence Policy
Structured output only. Confidence <= 0.80 requires human review.

## 4. Callback & Review Receipt
NestJS owns persistence, ReviewTask and Notification lifecycle.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $node["Code: Normalize Qualification Input"].json.prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Gemini Qualification
nodes.notes: GEMINI_API_KEY is read from n8n environment. Do not embed credentials in workflow JSON.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { eventId: $node['Code: Validate Event'].json.eventId, leadId: $node['Code: Apply Confidence Policy'].json.leadId, workflowRunId: $node['Code: Apply Confidence Policy'].json.workflowRunId, reviewTaskId: $json.reviewTaskId, qualificationId: $json.qualification?.id } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Notify Reviewer
nodes.notes: Read-only receipt endpoint. Callback owns ReviewTask/Notification creation; this node must not create a duplicate.

description: Owner: Tuấn Anh. Related Use Case: UC02. Exactly 12 functional nodes; Sticky Notes excluded. Backend persistence and ReviewTask lifecycle remain NestJS-owned.
